reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, and I don't finish what I start. The lab report is nice, but it doesn't make me need one more bottle in the house.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule for less per day? I'd wait for a flash sale or a coupon, and a launch price that ends in January doesn't beat the deals I can find on my own.
would_change_my_mind: A deeper flash-sale price, around $17 to $18 a box, or a coupon stack that gets it near $0.60 a day, plus a clear reason the single form beats the 8-form ones.
